implementation: Extends NumericConvert admission to shape-preserving CPU tensors. Ranked MLIR loops reuse the unchanged scalar converter per lane with both source/destination size checks and ArithmeticFault guards. Existing checked ABI, invocation ownership, task layouts and continuation kernels are reused.

contract.spelling: numeric type names as unary calls on completed CPU tensors; int/uint/float aliases retain 64-bit meanings
contract.shape: rank, extents and dynamic extent identities preserved; rank zero stays a one-element tensor; empty dimensions preserved
contract.numerics: same checked integer ranges, truncation, RNE rounding, changed-width NaN canonicalization and raw-bit identity as qualified scalar conversions
contract.input: immutable; noncontiguous borrowed views supported; source annotations remain required for tensor literals in current subset
contract.failure: ArithmeticFault at cast location; no partial tensor result; worker TaskError.Fault Arithmetic; allocation/cancellation cleanup

qualification.scope: Focused qualification and affected regression run, not the full 337-test suite
coverage: all 36 tensor conversion pairs at rank two and 12 representative rank-zero/one/three pairs
shared independent scalar APFloat/APSInt/__int128 oracle and boundary/random corpus
all valid rank-two corpus values; invalid values sampled across corpus at first/middle/last positions
displaced padded/transposed views, immutable inputs and exact retained output bits after invocation settlement
eight ARM floating environments and no floating exception flags
rank zero, empty dimensions, static destination byte overflow, dynamic source and destination byte bounds
source-located Arithmetic faults and no partial payload; allocation failure and cooperative cancellation
all six worker output families, all 36 mixed helper pairs, direct builtin casts and nested/cached awaits
owned input recovery, empty worker results and same-sized layout impostor rejection
scheduler and invocation allocation injection positions 1-32 with 1/2/4 workers
worker cancellation, deadlines, admission rejection and zero settled state
scalar conversion and existing tensor/worker/float32 Metal regressions

remaining_gates: public native library ABI/object/static/shared output qualification
native distributed execution design review before implementation
